_comment: Wichita — generation-A workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Wichita, KS MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 5 MSA counties (Sedgwick, Butler, Harvey, Sumner, Kingman), Butler (Kansas), Harvey (Kansas), Sumner (Kansas), Kingman (Kansas)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 23 geocoded venue(s) of 25 in this batch (observed lat 37.5538..38.0498, lng -97.4601..-96.8489).
msa: Wichita, KS (Sedgwick, Butler, Harvey, Sumner, Kingman counties)
_same_site_comment: No venue_facts block: every verified fact for these four rows (Edgemoor Rec indoor/3/fee, Edgemoor Park outdoor/12/free, 13th Street outdoor/4/free, Andover Community Center indoor/reservation_required/fee) already matches the workbook exactly, so writing an override would be a no-op that only obscures where the value came from.

same_site_pairs.note: Edgemoor Recreation Center (indoor, 3 courts, drop-in fee) sits inside Edgemoor Park (outdoor, 12 courts, free). The city lists both at 5815 E 9th, which is why they geocoded onto one house-number point.

13th Street Sports Park (outdoor, 4 courts, free) and the Andover Community Center (indoor, reservation-required, fee) share 1008 E 13th Street. The city publishes a separate page for the community center: https://www.andoverks.gov/877/Andover-Community-Center
